notes.title: Playrooms Reimagined + Pinkrooms Puzzle Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]✨ Surprise Update Announcement![/h1][p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We’re thrilled to share some exciting news with you — a surprise update is just around the corner, and here’s what you can expect:[/p][h2]🌀 Playrooms Chapter — Completely Remade[/h2][p]Based on community feedback that the [i]Playrooms[/i] chapter felt more like a maze than a true liminal space, we’ve rebuilt it from the ground up. The brand-new version will be available in just a few days![/p][list][*][p]It will fully replace the old chapter. Players who have already progressed can simply select [b]Chapter 4[/b] and continue from there.[/p][/*][*][p]Staying true to our vision, interaction remains a key part of [i]Liminal Shift[/i]. In the new [i]Playrooms[/i], you’ll need to open a gate. Don’t worry — it’s not even a puzzle. Just explore, interact with a couple of objects, and the path forward will reveal itself.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/171ce6147639c41fa5e58f5186c820cdc673f405.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h2]🌸 Pinkrooms Puzzle — Redesigned[/h2][p]We’ve heard your feedback! Around half of the players found the puzzle in [i]Pinkrooms[/i] frustrating or out of place. To improve the experience:[/p][list][*][p]The puzzle has been replaced with one that better matches the atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p]Interactions that could cause bugs or softlocks have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][h2]⚙️ General Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Significant [b]optimization upgrades[/b] have been made across the game.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]VHS setting bug[/b] in the options menu, reported by some players, has now been resolved.[/p][/*][/list][h2]👀 Bonus News[/h2][p]NextPhase is also working on a brand-new backrooms game — this time [b]fast-paced[/b], featuring [b]entities, chase sequences, and full voice acting[/b]. Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: LIMINAL SHIFT FULL RELEASE V1.0
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone[/b], 

with this update, Liminal Shift is leaving early access. First of all, thank you so much for your unwavering support from the very beginning! Without you, Liminal Shift would not exist. Now, let's get to the changes, new features, some notes I'll be leaving, and general problems and their solutions.[/p][list][*][p]Autosave has been removed and replaced with a progression system. The game will now secure and save your progress at specific points, and a notification will appear in the bottom right corner when this happens.[/p][/*][*][p]You can access the new chapter from the Episode 2 section. Please don't forget to read the notes that appear when you click on Episode 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Episode 1 and Episode 2 have been connected to form a loop, which is designed to represent the infinite cycle of Liminal Shift.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/20cb58f25c20cd9b9de5a83f1f523230b87e008b.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]Frequently Asked Questions and Answers, and some reminders:[/h3][list][*][p][b]The game is very dark:[/b] Yes, some levels are intentionally dark. This was done by design. Look around for a glowing light source, move towards it, and you will reach the light. This enhances the tension and atmosphere. There are no sections in the game where you can get lost in the darkness.[/p][/*][*][p][b]I'm having trouble with the settings:[/b] Please remember to press "Apply Settings" in the bottom right after changing your settings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]My game is crashing:[/b] If the game crashes while a level is loading, the reason is, 99.9% of the time, insufficient GPU VRAM. A minimum of 6GB of VRAM is recommended. As a solution, do not shift your computer's focus to another window while levels are loading. Close any applications that might be using VRAM. If it crashes between levels, it's because the texture data can't fit into the VRAM. Restarting the game and launching the desired level will solve the problem (lowering the resolution, etc., before starting the level can help as it will reduce the VRAM load).[/p][/*][*][p][b]I can't progress in the Pinkrooms level:[/b] You can join our Discord server and ask for help, or get assistance from the gameplay videos that will be uploaded to YouTube. The Pinkrooms is an additional level that includes puzzle elements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The audio levels are very unbalanced:[/b] You can adjust all sounds like footsteps, effects, and ambient sounds separately to your liking from the settings menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Don't forget to use the VHS mode in the settings for extra realism and a Found Footage video feel.[/u][/b][/p][p]Thank you again for being supportive throughout this journey from the very beginning. You can reach out to us with all your questions or problems via Discord and the community hub.
[/p][p][b]Without you, Liminal Shift would not exist[/b]. Thank you for everything![/p]

notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone,[/h2]

First of all, I want to apologize for the delay. A lot has happened, and those who joined our Discord server (currently around 100 members) are already aware of most of the news. If you'd like to support the development, share your ideas, or just stay in the loop, feel free to join us too. So, I’ll keep this announcement brief and to the point.

Unfortunately, there is no longer a team behind the project. As many of you know, NextPhase was a small group of developers. However, due to financial constraints and life circumstances, NextPhase is now a solo-dev operation. There's no need to worry—everything is still on track. The entire concept of Liminal Shift, its artistic direction, and design have always been mine as the creator and lead developer. These changes won’t affect the quality of the game, but the roadmap has shifted and, unfortunately, development will take a bit longer. Now, let’s get into the exciting updates and what’s changing!

[h2]Chapter 2 is now titled the Bonus Chapter.[/h2]

This chapter will be significantly different from the first episode. It won’t be just a [b]walking simulator[/b]—expect more [b]horror, interactivity, and puzzles[/b] that will require you to think in order to progress. Because of these differences, it will come with a content disclaimer and be labeled as a "Bonus Chapter." Development has already begun, and a large part of its design is already completed. Here are some details about it:

[h2][b]PINKROOMS[/b][/h2]

In this bonus chapter, you’ll find yourself in [b]Level 947[/b]—a seemingly peaceful backrooms level. At first glance, it appears [b]cute and calm[/b], but beneath the surface lies something deeply unsettling. You may encounter an [strike]entity[/strike], and you'll need to take certain actions to move forward through this surreal home. Your goal is to find a way out. Remember: while Level 947 might be considered safe, you [strike]should NOT[/strike] stay there for too long.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/851c9225144c75237408ec45eb28b9e59b0ef981.png[/img]
[h2]YouTube, Devlogs[/h2]

I’m also excited to share another piece of news: I’ll be starting [b]devlogs on YouTube[/b] very soon!
Through short and fun videos, I’ll be sharing everything from what the game has gone through to how Liminal Shift is being developed and what’s coming in the future. This is a great step forward for [b]NextPhase[/b], so subscribing to the YouTube channel would be an [b]AMAZING[/b] way to support the project!

YouTube Link: https://www.youtube.com/@NextPhaseStudios

[h2]Now, let’s talk about some upcoming changes to the current build of the game:[/h2]

-There are certain moments in Liminal Shift where the silence is both peaceful and terrifying, it makes you hesitate before taking your next step. To heighten these feelings and enhance the sense of progress, [b]the free save system will be replaced by a checkpoint-based system[/b] in the next menu update.

-I’m aware of the bug that causes you to fall out of the world in the office corridor, and this will be fixed with the upcoming menu update.

-If you encounter any more bugs before the full release, feel free to report them via Discord. I’ll personally take care of them (after all, there’s no one else left, funny but true).

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/zrNJBmhxSu

[b]Liminal Shift[/b] will officially release with the [b]Pinkrooms[/b] chapter. However, the number of bonus chapters may increase in the future, and existing chapters may be improved or expanded. That entirely depends on you and your feedback.

With Pinkrooms, we’re taking a major step toward making [b]Liminal Shift[/b] stand out from other liminal space games, just as we always intended.

Thank you so much for reading.
Your support through [b]Discord[/b], [b]YouTube subscriptions[/b], and simply [b]liking this announcement[/b] means the world to me.

With respect,
See you soon!

notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone,[/h2]

First of all, we apologize for the slight delay. We have some survey results, good news, and bad news to share. Let’s start with the results.

[list]
[*] 75% of players agreed that walking and running speeds should be increased. As a result, the character’s movement speed will be reviewed again.
[*] 82% of players voted for changes to the menu and progression system. In response, the entire menu has been redesigned, and a progression system has been integrated into the game.
[*] 68% of players wanted small puzzles and actions required to progress. Based on this, Episode 2 will be much more interactive, featuring objects to find and use. Additionally, we have carefully read all the suggestions left in the final text box. Your ideas will play a significant role in Episode 2.
[/list]
[h3]Now for the bad news:[/h3] Due to the small size of our team and financial challenges, we unfortunately have to indefinitely postpone Episode 2 for now. However, this indefinite delay won’t last too long. We don’t want to keep you waiting too much, but we ask for your understanding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/6210fa872e7a5a3a8eb9b666f45740b55d72add3.png[/img]
We’ve taken note of your ideas and expectations for Episode 2 and a unique liminal experience—a semi-open world filled with abandoned, desolate neighborhoods and streets, with a deeply eerie atmosphere. This aligns perfectly with our vision. We want to create a semi-open world where every player can wander and relax, sometimes feeling uneasy, with each area being distinct and unique. More interactions, required materials for progression, and much more are part of our plans.

We will be sharing more information and videos about Episode 2 soon. However, for now, we must fully postpone the roadmap. We’ll try to release an announcement with exact dates as soon as possible. Please remember that NextPhase is still a small studio in terms of both manpower and finances. We are doing our absolute best to make sure the wait is worth it.

Thank you once again for your understanding and support! If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us in the comments and discussions—we read and carefully consider every message.

See you at next updates!

notes.title: LIMINAL SHIFT EARLY ACCESS V1.1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Everyone![/h2]

The long-awaited date has arrived! We apologize for the slight delay—it took us some time to resolve a few issues. But now, we have some huge news for you! Let’s dive right in!

You spoke, we listened! One of the biggest problems and complaints during the early access phase is now completely resolved with this update! Introducing [b]a fully dynamic free save and checkpoint system[/b]! Yes, from now on, every time you return to the main menu, you can simply press the Continue button and pick up right where you left off.

Additionally, since Episode 1 is now complete, we have locked all chapters and [b]implemented a progression system based on your requests[/b]. Now, in order to unlock new chapters, you’ll need to play through and complete the previous ones!

[h2]Now for the real big news![/h2]

[b]The main menu design and functionality have been completely overhauled![/b] Settings now work flawlessly, and all your customizations are saved instantly, ensuring a smoother and more seamless experience.

When you enter the main menu, you’ll notice a surprise! The environment you see belongs to [b]Liminal Shift: Episode 2![/b] Our team has started experimenting with [b]visual effects and design prototypes[/b] for Episode 2, and the background of the main menu is taken directly from an area in the upcoming episode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/c75b549a29de90d0087bf55adba1e824e2a1c001.png[/img]
[h2]Episode 2 – A Unique Vision[/h2]

We have some unprecedented ideas for [b]Episode 2[/b]. We are considering making it [b]a semi-open world[/b], delivering [u]a truly one-of-a-kind[/u] liminal experience like never before. However, nothing is set in stone yet, and we are still in the experimental stages.

Soon, we will release a [b]poll[/b] to gather your feedback and adjust our direction accordingly. But one thing is certain: what you will experience will be unlike anything you've seen before. That being said, such big ideas may likely result in a delay for the full release of the game.

[b]Episode 2 will be completely free[/b] for everyone who owns the game! It will offer a completely different experience from Episode 1, with more [u]horror elements[/u]—you may even encounter [u]strangers[/u].

[h2]Thank You for Your Support![/h2]

Thank you for being with us from the beginning! Your ideas matter to us, and we will be collecting more of your thoughts soon. Remember, this is just the beginning! We’ll see you again soon—drop your comments below, and we wish you an unforgettable experience!

notes.title: LIMINAL SHIFT ROADMAP
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

First of all, we would like to thank each and every one of you for your interest in and support for Liminal Shift! As we’ve always said, we have many plans for Liminal Shift and are absolutely committed to continuing its development. This announcement will fully inform you about the future of Liminal Shift, so we kindly ask you to read it.

First, we apologize once again for any delays or potential delays. Please remember that NextPhase is still a small game studio, and any developer falling ill can disrupt the entire development process. Thank you once again for your patience and support.

We’ve prepared a roadmap for you, which you can see below. Let’s dive into the detailed explanation of this roadmap:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/0fa2634a7b8b7b39f43a73ef4a4e172f3a29cd8c.png[/img]

[h2]New Chapter / Fisheye Effect Disable Option[/h2]

As we mentioned before, when Liminal Shift was released in early access, our ideas were not yet finalized. We don’t want to finish Liminal Shift until it fully aligns with our vision. That’s why, on February 10th, we’re adding a new chapter between Chapter 5 and Chapter 6. This chapter will be connected to Chapter 5 and will offer approximately 30 minutes of gameplay. It will feature a darker and more chaotic concept! Additionally, on February 10th, we’re introducing a Fisheye Effect Disable Option to ensure that everyone can experience Liminal Shift in the most enjoyable way possible.

[h2]Your Opinion[/h2]

On February 12th, we’re introducing something completely new! We’ll launch a survey and a form to gather your feedback about the game. Through this survey, you’ll be able to share the features and content you’d like to see in the game. However, there will be some conditions: your suggestions must not compromise the essence of the game. Liminal Shift is an atmospheric thriller that does not include monsters, chases, or jump scares. You’ll be able to share your ideas while staying true to the game’s core identity. We want Liminal Shift to stand out and diversify with your input!

[h2]Implementing Your Opinion[/h2]

On February 25th, we’ll review all the surveys and forms, and begin turning your ideas into reality!

[h2]New Chapter / Ultimate VHS Experience
[/h2]
On March 10th, a completely new chapter is coming! You can think of this as Episode 2—a brand-new experience that will differ from the first story and setting. Additionally, on March 10th, we’re introducing a brand-new VHS Experience, where everything will feel almost entirely real! You’ll feel the full effect and tension of a VHS tape like never before.

[h2]Full Release / New Chapter
[/h2]
On April 15th, we’re bringing another completely new chapter! This chapter will be connected to Episode 2 and serve as its continuation. With this new chapter and Episode 2, Liminal Shift will officially transition to its full release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/a7c99964fb42b95d8b264279fabd4e9b59780912.png[/img]

Thank you for being with us on this journey from the very beginning. As we promised on day one, we strive to engage with all discussions and listen to everyone’s opinions. Thank you again for everything, and we’ll keep you updated if there are any changes. See you on February 10th!

notes.title: HOTFIX V0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Hello! [/h1] 
First of all, we would like to thank you for your interest in the demo of *Liminal Shift* over the past five days.  
We’ve been carefully listening to all your feedback and have been updating the game accordingly. Here are some of the improvements:  
[h1]
Fixes:  [/h1]
[list]
[*] An issue where water appeared floating incorrectly for some players has been resolved.  
[*] Missing sounds have been restored, and overall sound accuracy has been improved.  
[*] Lighting and reflection issues encountered by some players have been fixed.  
[/list]

[h1]New Features:  [/h1]
[list]
[*] A new option to adjust head-bobbing intensity has been added to the settings menu!
[*] Controller support added!   
[*] Floating companions have been added to the Poolrooms chapter to keep you company!  
[*] Updates introduced in Chapter 2's full version are now available in the demo!  
[*] A bug causing the same sound to play repeatedly when answering ringing phones has been fixed!  
[*] Lighting and reflection consistency has been enhanced!  
[*] Atmospheric sounds added in the full version are now part of the demo!  
[*] Various design improvements have been implemented!  
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has supported us from the beginning. We’ve heard you and will continue to listen.  

Liminal Shift is set to release in its full version on December 25th, with no changes to the release date for now.  
See you on December 25th, We'll explore the unknown together!

notes.title: DEMO HOTFIX V0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

First of all, we want to thank each and every one of you who tried the demo version of Liminal Shift in this early stage!

We’ve been listening to your feedback, fixing bugs, and introducing new features. Here are some highlights:

[h1]Hotfix v0.1[/h1]
[list]
[*] Soft lock bug fixed: Resolved an issue in the Poolrooms area where players could jump down and become stuck without a way back up.
[*] Missing sounds fixed: Improved missing sounds, as well as enhanced sound effects and echoes.
[*] Object collision fixed: Adjusted objects that caused unintended camera movements when approached.
[*] Lighting improvements: Enhanced lighting adjustments to improve quality in certain areas.
[*] Localization fixes: Addressed language-specific errors in localization.
[*] Major issue fixed: Resolved a widespread issue where glowing lights and materials would not render or function correctly for all players.
[/list]
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Footstep volume control: A new sound level adjustment feature has been added to the menu for footsteps.
[*] Updated rooms: New rooms from the full version's ongoing development have been integrated and updated in the demo.
[*] Design improvements: Corridors and rooms in Chapter 2 have received design updates in the demo.
[/list]
Once again, a huge thank you to the hundreds of players who tried the demo! We’re eager to hear your feedback. See you where emotions collide!

notes.title: DEMO RELEASED
notes.content:
This version is the demo of Liminal Shift's early access phase, offering you the chance to experience Chapters 2 and 3.
Since Liminal Shift is still in development, it may have various issues, bugs, and other shortcomings. The reason we’re sharing the game at this early stage is to listen to your feedback from the very beginning, embark on this journey together, and create a Liminal Shift where we can all truly lose ourselves.

Our team reviews and considers the comments you leave on our Steam page and the messages you send through Discord daily, using them to guide the game’s development. This isn’t just something we say, you’ll genuinely feel the impact of your feedback!

We look forward to your positive and constructive comments and hope you have an amazing time exploring the world of Liminal Shift.

You can always reach out to us through our Discord server, leave your thoughts on our store page, and support us by following the game. Together, let’s venture into the unknown!

notes.title: LIMINAL SHIFT RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We’re thrilled about the release of Liminal Shift, and we want to give players the ultimate liminal space experience like no other—capturing the feelings, the voices, and the sense of hope.

As you know, Liminal Shift will launch in Early Access because we want to embark on this journey together. Your feedback will play a crucial role in shaping the game. This isn’t just a promise—we genuinely mean it.

Even though it’s an Early Access launch, we aim to provide the best possible experience from the start. However, we need a little more time to ensure that.

The new release date for Liminal Shift is 25th December at 8:00 PM (PST).

Thank you for your patience. See you in the place where emotions fade away.
